name: Kenosis

phase_0.boundary_condition: The hypostatic union which contains the divine and human natures within a single person.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state of the Word before the incarnation event.

TANCH.justification: The final state of glory that bounds the entire process of descent and ascent.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement from divinity toward the assumption of human nature.

AREV.justification: The voluntary renunciation of divine prerogatives and descent into the form of a servant.

CLINK.justification: The sequential joining of the divine nature to the human nature without confusion.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-identical subject who remains the same throughout the transformation.

FSPLIT.justification: The distinction of the single person into divine and human operational capacities.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the distinct capacities into the single acting subject.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative alignment of the human will with the divine purpose.

EVALF.justification: The negative experience of limitation and mortality inherent in the kenotic state.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of the desire to avoid the cup and the desire to fulfill the mission.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible historical fixation of the kenotic act in time.

phase_3.void_description: The silence of the Father before the utterance of the Word.
phase_3.true_description: The fulfillment of the divine economy through perfect submission.
phase_3.false_description: The experience of abandonment and the reality of death.
phase_3.both_description: The God-Man existing as both immortal and mortal in one instance.

steps.domain_action: The Logos exists in the eternal state of the Pleroma.
The Logos identifies as the self-same subject of the coming action.
The Logos initiates the movement toward the finite world.
The single subject differentiates into the capacity for divine and human experience.
The divine capacity undergoes voluntary restriction and descent.
The subject experiences the limitations of hunger and fatigue.
The human capacity undergoes growth and development.
The subject maintains perfect moral alignment with the source.
The subject holds the tension of divine power and human vulnerability.
The distinct experiences of descent and growth unite in the single person.
The human and divine natures compose a single theanthropic operation.
The subject undergoes the irreversible event of the crucifixion.
The process concludes in the restoration of glory containing the human experience.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who effects the union of natures.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The communicatio idiomatum where properties of both natures are predicated of the one person.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Sacred Tradition which preserves the record of the kenotic event.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Kairos which dictates the fullness of time for each stage of the descent.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Chalcedonian Definition which provides the formal logic for the union.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The voluntary expenditure of glory and the endurance of temporal finitude.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Infinite divine plenitude without human experience.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Infinite divine plenitude containing and glorifying the human experience.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The total ontological value is conserved as the emptying is a mode of revelation rather than a loss of being.
